text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, the hands holding the plushie
were trembling faintly.
choice_data_list: Is it really made that well?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, the plushie is wonderful too, but
what is even more extraordinary is—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's skill
in maneuvering the crane.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Eyes that can gauge spring tension...
Fingers that move with precision, exactly as envisioned.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I was shown something truly wonderful.
—I must learn from it.
